docs.title: About common-access-model
docs.text: Internal Access model for the INCLUDE DCC.

docs.title: Custom Artifact Generation (dbt)
docs.text:
We have a handful of custom scripts that build various artifacts required by different components of the various data pipeline components. These should all be handled by the CI/CD pipeline and added to the release's Assets list.

  • The SQL Alchemy model is available directly from the assets list as a whl file and can be added to your python distribution using @git+{url} syntax.
  • The all artifacts generated by the just site recipe can be found inside the release assets' project_artifacts.zip file.

To trigger the production of these assets, a new release should be created with a semantic version based tag that starts with v: v1.0.0, etc.

docs.title: The dbt Recipe
docs.text:
A dumb wrapper recipe has been created with dependencies to trigger the production of each of those dbt related artifacts.

This recipe has been added as a dependency of the standard recipe, site.

just dbt

Example command to add the model to your uv based python project:

uv add common_access_model@https://github.com/include-dcc/common-access-model/releases/download/0.0.1/common_access_model-0.0.0.post89.dev0+d378cee-py3-none-any.whl

Please note the releases/download/0.0.1 portion of the url. That is to a specific version of the model itself, which is by design. You will need to update your project each time you want to update to a new model.

In a similar fashion, you can install it via pip or add it to your pyproject.toml file using a similar pattern.

docs.title: SQL Alchemy Model
docs.text:
Many of our tools rely on the SQL Alchemy models produced using LinkML's SQL Alchemy generator. We've added just recipe's to run build these:

just sqla

The resulting file is found inside project/sqlalchemy/{model_name}.py

docs.title: Data Dictionary csv files
docs.text:
The pipeline utitilies created by the FTD team rely on csv data dictionaries to the target .sql files.

just _gen_ftddd

Resulting csv files can be found inside: project/data-dictionary/*.csv

Each class from the model and any of the SQL specific join tables will be found in their own file, conforming to the FTD DD Format.

docs.title: Model Enums
docs.text:
This is a CSV file that contains each enumeration and it's home within the datamodel. It is used by the dbt pipeline utitilies. This is a secondary artifact from the _gen_ftddd recipe.

The resulting file is found inside project/enumerations/model_enums.csv

docs.title: dbt Model
docs.text:
A complete model that can be immediately dropped into your dbt pipeline can be generated that features various dbt tests based on the model's definition including:

  • valid_uri_format
  • foreign key target must exist
  • uri-or-curie
  • multi-column keys
  • not null
  • unique
  • allowable values

The resulting file is found inside project/dbt/src_dev_include_access.yml

The filename is purely a placeholder and should be renamed to whatever makes sense for your needs.

docs.text: The type of data within this file.

docs.title: Slot: Data Use Accession (data_use_accession)
docs.text: Accession used to provision access to the record, eg, a dbGaP phsID.

docs.title: Slot: Data Use Modifier (data_use_modifier)
docs.text: Additional modifiers that limit data use.

docs.title: Slot: Data Use Permission (data_use_permission)
docs.text: Broad category of restrictions on data use.

docs.title: Slot: Dataset ID (dataset_id)
docs.text: Unique identifier for a Dataset.

docs.title: Slot: Description (description)
docs.text: Description for this entity.

docs.title: Slot: Data Use Disease Limitation (disease_limitation)
docs.text: If the access is limited to a specific disease purpose, it is specified here.

docs.title: Slot: Display String (display)
docs.text: The friendly display string of the coded term.

docs.title: Slot: DOI (do_id)
docs.text: Digital Object Identifier (DOI) for this Record.

docs.title: Slot: DRS URI (drs_uri)
docs.text: DRS location to access the data.

docs.title: Slot: Email Address (email)
docs.text: An email address to reach the entity.

docs.title: Slot: Encounter Definition ID (encounter_definition_id)
docs.text: Unique identifier for this Encounter Definition.

docs.title: Slot: Encounter ID (encounter_id)
docs.text: Unique identifier for this Encounter.

docs.title: Slot: Ethnicity (ethnicity)
docs.text: Ethnicity of Participant

docs.title: Slot: Expected Number of Participants (expected_number_of_participants)
docs.text: Total expected number of participants to be recruited.

docs.title: Slot: External Identifiers (external_id)
docs.text: Other identifiers for this entity, eg, from the submitting study or in systems like dbGaP

docs.title: Slot: family_description
docs.text: Free text describing the study family, such as potential inheritance or details about consanguinity

docs.title: Slot: Family ID (family_id)
docs.text: Global ID for the Family

docs.title: Slot: family_member_id
docs.text: The family member Subject who is the relationship "subject".

docs.title: Slot: Family Relationship ID (family_membership_id)
docs.text: ID for the Family Relationship

docs.title: Slot: Family Relationship ID (family_relationship_id)
docs.text: Global ID for the Family Relationship

docs.title: Slot: family_role
docs.text: The "role" of this individual in this family. Could include terms like "proband", "mother", etc.

docs.title: Slot: family_study_focus
docs.text: The specific focus of the investigation, eg, a condition.

docs.title: Slot: family_type
docs.text: Describes the 'type' of study family, eg, trio.

docs.title: Slot: File Extension (file_extension)
docs.text: Typically a 3-4 letter code at the end of a filename that identifies the file format. Empty string for no extension.

docs.title: Slot: File ID (file_id)
docs.text: Unique identifier for this File.

docs.title: Slot: Filename (filename)
docs.text: The name of the file.

docs.title: Slot: File Format (format)
docs.text: The format of the file.

docs.title: Slot: Funding Source (funding_source)
docs.text: The funding source(s) of the study.

docs.title: Slot: File Hash (hash)
docs.text: File hash information

docs.title: Slot: File Hash Type (hash_type)
docs.text: The type of file hash, eg, md5

docs.title: Slot: File Hash Value (hash_value)
docs.text: The value of the file hash

docs.title: Slot: Institution (institution)
docs.text: Name of the institution this record is associated with.

docs.title: Slot: Internal Staging Location (internal_uri)
docs.text: URI/URL for internal access to the data. May be temporary.

docs.title: Slot: Investigator Title (investigator_title)
docs.text: The title of the Investigator, eg, "Assistant Professor"

docs.title: Slot: Location Laterality (laterality)
docs.text: Laterality that further refine the specific location of biospecimen collection

docs.title: Slot: Biospecimen Collection Method (method)
docs.text: The approach used to collect the biospecimen.

docs.title: Slot: Name (name)
docs.text: Name of the entity.

docs.title: Slot: Organism Type (organism_type)
docs.text: Organism Type, typically from NCBITaxon.

docs.title: Slot: Parent Sample ID (parent_sample_id)
docs.text: Sample from which this sample is derived

docs.title: Slot: Parent Study (parent_study)
docs.text: The parent study for this study, if it is a nested study.

docs.title: Slot: Participant Lifespan Stage (participant_lifespan_stage)
docs.text: Focus age group(s) of the study population

docs.title: Slot: Principal Investigator (principal_investigator)
docs.text: The Principal Investigator(s) responsible for the study.

docs.title: Slot: Sample Processing (processing)
docs.text: Processing that was applied to the Parent Sample or from the Biospecimen Collection that yielded this distinct sample. OBI is recommended.

docs.title: Slot: Program (program)
docs.text: Funding source(s) for the study

docs.title: Slot: Publication (publication)
docs.text: Publications associated with this Record.

docs.title: Slot: Quantity (quantity_number)
docs.text: The total quantity of the specimen

docs.title: Slot: Quantity Units (quantity_unit)
docs.text: The structured term defining the units of the quantity.

docs.title: Slot: Race (race)
docs.text: Race of Participant

docs.title: Slot: relation
docs.text: Code definting the relationship predicate. Relationship of the "Family Member" to the "Subject", eg, mother of. Ideally uses KIN ontology.

docs.title: Slot: Release Location (release_uri)
docs.text: URI/URL for controlled or open access to the data.

docs.title: Slot: research_domain
docs.text: Main research domain(s) of the study

docs.title: Slot: Sample ID (sample_id)
docs.text: The unique identifier for this Sample.

docs.title: Slot: Sample Type (sample_type)
docs.text: Type of material of which this Sample is comprised. UBERON is recommended.

docs.title: Slot: Selection Criteria (selection_criteria)
docs.text: Brief description of inclusion and/or exclusion criteria for the study

docs.title: Slot: Sex (sex)
docs.text: Sex of Participant

docs.title: Slot: Biospecimen Collection Site (site)
docs.text: The location of the specimen collection.

docs.title: Slot: File Size (size)
docs.text: Size of the file, in Bytes. May require BigInt or similar.

docs.title: Slot: Spatial Qualifier (spatial_qualifier)
docs.text: Qualifier that further refine the specific location of biospecimen collection

docs.title: Slot: Storage Class (storage_class)
docs.text: Storage class of the object, reflecting cost and access characteristics.

docs.title: Slot: Sample Storage Method (storage_method)
docs.text: Sample storage method, eg, Frozen or with additives. OBI may be suitable, or ChEBI for additives.

docs.title: Slot: Study Code (study_code)
docs.text: Unique identifier for the study (generally a short acronym)

docs.title: Slot: Study Description (study_description)
docs.text: Brief description of the study (2-4 sentences)

docs.title: Slot: Study Design (study_design)
docs.text: Overall design of study, including whether it is longitudinal and whether family members/unrelated controls are also enrolled

docs.title: Slot: Study ID (study_id)
docs.text: INCLUDE Global ID for the study

docs.title: Slot: Study Code (study_short_name)
docs.text: Short name for the study

docs.title: Slot: study_title
docs.text: Full Study Title

docs.title: Slot: Study ID (subject_id)
docs.text: INCLUDE Global ID for the Subject

docs.title: Slot: Subject Type (subject_type)
docs.text: Type of entity this record represents

docs.title: Slot: Value concept (value_concept)
docs.text: The structured term defining the value of the assertion.

docs.title: Slot: Value Number (value_number)
docs.text: The numeric value of the assertion.

docs.title: Slot: Value Source Text (value_source)
docs.text: The source text yielding the value.

docs.title: Slot: Value Units (value_unit)
docs.text: The structured term defining the units of the value.

docs.title: Slot: Value Units Source Text (value_unit_source)
docs.text: The source text yielding the value's units.

docs.title: Slot: Virtual Biorepository (vbr_id)
docs.text: Information about the study's Virtual Biorepository, if participating

docs.title: Slot: VBR Readme (vbr_readme)
docs.text: Instructions for contacting or requesting samples from Virtual Biorepository, if participating

docs.title: Slot: Vital Status (vital_status)
docs.text: Whether participant is alive or dead

docs.title: Slot: Website (website)
docs.text: Website with more information about this entity.
